title: Extreme Risk Protective Order
summary: Petitioning for and serving a temporary ERPO.

steps.text: Identify the danger: recent threats, violence, order violations, reckless firearm use, substance abuse
Check firearm records and permits for the respondent
Complete the petition with specific, sworn facts
Notify a supervisor and the ERPO coordinator or prosecutor
Serve the temporary order and explain its terms
Take custody of firearms, ammunition and permits covered by the order
If the respondent won't comply, seek a search warrant
Give receipts and complete the return of service

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
